notes.title: liteCam Discontinued on Steam
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Dear liteCam Users,[/p][p][/p][p]We would like to inform you that [b]liteCam has been discontinued on Steam effective immediately[/b]. It is no longer available for purchase or download on the Steam platform.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Customers who already purchased liteCam can continue to use the product without interruption.[/p][/*][*][p]However, there will be no further updates or new feature releases.[/p][/*][*][p]Technical support will remain available through our official support site:[/p][p]👉 [url="https://help.litecam.net/hc/en-us"]https://help.litecam.net/hc/en-us[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We sincerely appreciate your support and understanding, and we thank you for being part of the liteCam community.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]The liteCam Team[/p]
